name: Icon
purpose: Decorative or semantic glyph with explicit RTL behavior.
scenarios: Show a directional glyph that flips in RTL
Preserve a symmetric icon across reading directions
Provide a locale-aware icon that the consumer localizes

children.description: Optional SVG or glyph content; a default arrow is used when omitted.

variants.name: mode
variants.description: Controls whether the icon is mirrored, preserved, or localized for RTL.

states.name: default
states.description: Icon is rendered with its declared mode.

antiPatterns: Do not hide the accessible name when the icon conveys meaning.
Do not mirror symmetric icons; use mode=preserve.

a11y.focus: Icon is not focusable; it is decorative or labelled by a parent.
a11y.labeling: A visible or aria-label accessible name is required when the icon conveys meaning.

responsive.strategy: Scales with the font size of its parent. No breakpoint-specific behavior.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. mode=mirror applies a scaleX transform; mode=preserve keeps the glyph; mode=localized defers to the consumer glyph.
